item.text:
When a command runs, Cobra checks whether `c.Deprecated` is non-empty. If so, it prints:

```text
Command "<name>" is deprecated, <deprecation message>
```

Evidence: `command.go:879-881`:

```go
if len(c.Deprecated) > 0 {
    c.Printf("Command %q is deprecated, %s\n", c.Name(), c.Deprecated)
}
```
